meta.topic: bazhai (八宅風水: 命卦 / 遊年八星 / 宅卦 / 命宅配)
meta.generator: independent recomputation in Python 3.13 (classical 排山掌訣 + closed form + yao-change walk); not copied from tools/lib/divine_bazhai.py

conventions.five_rule: raw number 5 -> male uses 坤(2), female uses 艮(8)
conventions.minggua_closed_form: male: n = mod9(2 - Y) ; female: n = mod9(Y + 4) ; mod9 maps 0 -> 9 ; Y = 干支年 (立春為界)
conventions.minggua_equivalent_digit_formulas: 1900-1999: male mod9(100-yy) female mod9(yy-4) ; 2000-2099: male mod9(99-yy) female mod9(yy+6)
conventions.default_boundary: lichun_exact (太陽黃經315度的交節時刻, 台灣時間 UTC+8, 分鐘精度)
conventions.timezone: lichun_cst table is UTC+8. Asia/Taipei tzdata: clock offset at each 立春 instant is +08:00 for 1900-2050 except 1938-1945 (JST +09:00); Taiwan DST never covered early February. Convert recorded local birth time to UTC+8 before comparing.
conventions.sector_boundary: octant/mountain boundaries treated as half-open [start, end) clockwise (design choice; sources silent)

meta.lichun_validation: Skyfield+JPL DE421 for 1900-2050 (agrees with HKO official XML to the minute for 2019-2028; max 46 s vs lunar_python over 1900-2050); 2051-2100 from lunar_python only (unverified, +-1 min). Treat any birth within +-2 minutes of 立春 as uncertain.
